hypotheses.R0_trace_and_basis_are_valid: Independent traced logits agree with the checkpoint forward to at most 1e-5, and the pooled rank-32 oracle beats an equal-rank random basis by at least 0.30 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R1_pre_final_local_router_is_sufficient: At the boundary after Layer 10, at least one frozen feature family reaches fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of the rank-32 oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_mid_depth_router_is_sufficient: At some boundary no later than Layer 6, one feature family reaches fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_context_specific_coefficients_matter: At the earliest universally sufficient boundary, predicted coefficients exceed within-corpus permuted predicted coefficients by at least 0.15 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_nonlinear_local_features_add_value: At some boundary on every corpus, polynomial features improve fidelity over delta-only features by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R5_router_quality_generally_increases_wi: For every corpus, the best-family fidelity has Spearman correlation at least 0.70 with boundary depth.
hypotheses.R6_one_frozen_router_transfers_ood: The same FineWeb-trained family and depth that first pass the FineWeb gate also pass the 0.70/within-0.15 gate on WikiText and TinyStories.
